text: Your video call skips a few frames. You keep talking. But can a robot goalkeeper keep saving?
We gave our duck the same fresh shots, then made its overhead-camera packets disappear. No delay. No secret ball position.
First surprise: one hundred fifteen of two hundred ten frames vanished, and it still saved all fifteen shots. Apparently, this duck can fill in some blanks.
Then we removed one hundred sixty-eight frames. Same robot. Same shots. Now five goals slipped through.
Ten saves out of fifteen misses our twelve-save bar. It never fell; it simply ran out of useful pictures.
So we'll add loss detection and a fallback, then test bursts instead of random gaps. Because Wi-Fi rarely fails politely.
